Name: Fisk's Secret
OutcomeConditions: Fresh own completion legend; correlated actual resources and active reward; terminal popup closed
Unknown dialogue variants stop; no repeat of ambiguous payments, handoffs or claims

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Ah, pleasant sun to you, aisling. Would you do me a favor and keep a secret? *a look of need appears on his face*
Pages.Choice: I will help you and keep your secret.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Ah, wonderful!

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: I've had a secret crush on Bertil, the White Magic Master here in Suomi. I've been wondering for moons what I could do for her.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: I've been sneaking around Suomi in an attempt to find something to spark my passion. I've visited the various mundanes and noticed that a few of them possess very beautiful flowers.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: I cannot bring myself to steal the flowers. So, I would appreciate it greatly if you would visit these mundanes and convince them to give you a flower. Please do not reveal my secret.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: First, I would like you to get five water lilies from Thulin. You can find him at the Garamonde Theatre, just down the path.

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: Greetings, aisling. Yes, I have some water lilies that I use to decorate the theatre with. However, I need you to do me a favor first.
Pages.Choice: Sure. What do you need me to do?

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: My stock on wine is rather low. Would you mind buying five bottles of wine for me please?

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: I hear Viveka, at the Suomi Tavern, sells wine. Just say :wine: when you've returned with five bottles.

Journey.Evidence: Observed stock and purchase receipts in research fixtures
Journey.Label: Wine

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: Did you get the bottles of wine I asked for?

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: Oh. Thank you very much. Here are the flowers you asked for.

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: If you don't mind my asking...why did you need those flowers?
Pages.Choice: I cannot say. They are very much appreciated, though.

Pages.Speaker: Thulin
Pages.Text: Alright...farewell, aisling

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Ah, good to see you again. Did you get the water lilies I asked for?

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Wonderful! *takes the flowers from you*

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: I saw some wonderful purple colored petunias over in the Suomi Inn. Mind seeing if Eeva will spare you five of them?

Pages.Speaker: $character
Pages.Text: Certainly.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Thank you! Remember, don't reveal why you need them.

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Hello, aisling. Why yes, I do have several petunias throughout the inn. However, I'm craving something, also of a purple color. Would you mind fetching me some grapes, please?

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Thank you. Suomi has a Grape Farmer. His name is Alvar. I'm sure he won't mind if you pick some, for a small fee of course.

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Bring me back ten bunches of grapes. When you have them, just say :grapes:

Journey.Evidence: Observed stock and purchase receipts in research fixtures
Journey.Label: Grapes

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Oh, you have returned with the grapes I asked for?

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Lovely. Here are the petunias you requested.

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Pardon my asking, but why did you want those flowers?
Pages.Choice: I cannot say. I am grateful for them, though.

Pages.Speaker: Eeva
Pages.Text: Hmmm...

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Ah, good to see you again. Did you get the petunias I asked for?

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Marvelous! *takes the flowers from you*

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: The last flower I want, I found them in the Shrine of Deoch.

Pages.Speaker: $character
Pages.Text: No problem.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Perfect. Return when you have them and keep my secret, please.

Pages.Speaker: Vivianne
Pages.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Pages.Speaker: Vivianne
Pages.Text: Greetings and welcome to the Shrine of Deoch. *smiles brightly* How may I assist you?
Pages.Choice: I need a pink rose. Would you happen to have one?

Pages.Speaker: Vivianne
Pages.Text: Yes, I do have a few. Why do you need one?
Pages.Choice: I am helping someone make a bouquet, but I cannot tell you who.

Pages.Speaker: Vivianne
Pages.Text: Oh? *intrigued* Is that so? I cannot withhold this pink rose especially when an aisling needs it to create something.

Pages.Speaker: Vivianne
Pages.Text: However, the temple is in need a small charitable donation. Would you mind sparing 10,000 coins, please?

Pages.Speaker: Vivianne
Pages.Text: Thank you, kindly. Here you go.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Did you get the pink rose I asked for? *eager*

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Yes, at last! You didn't tell her anything, did you?

Pages.Speaker: $character
Pages.Text: Yes, I had to or she wouldn't give me the pink rose.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Did you tell her my name?

Pages.Speaker: $character
Pages.Text: No, I only said that someone was making a bouquet.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Ah. *much calmer* That's good to know.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: I need you to run these flowers over to Viveka, at the Suomi Tavern, and have her make a bouquet for me. Okay?

Pages.Speaker: $character
Pages.Text: Sure, why not.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Please have her place the pink rose in the middle.

Pages.Speaker: Viveka
Pages.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Pages.Speaker: Viveka
Pages.Text: Yes, I can make a flower bouquet for you but for a small price.

Pages.Speaker: Viveka
Pages.Text: I charge 20,000 coins per bouquet.
Pages.Choice: Here you go. Put the pink rose in the middle.

Pages.Speaker: Viveka
Pages.Text: Will do. Return to me in one hour and I shall have it ready for you.

Pages.Speaker: Viveka
Pages.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Pages.Speaker: Viveka
Pages.Text: Ah, yes. Here is your flower bouquet. Have a wonderful sun.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: That looks beautiful. *takes the bouquet and Attaches a letter to it*

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Deliver this to Bertil and do not tell her who it is from.

Pages.Speaker: Bertil
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Bertil
Pages.Text: Oh, this bouquet is for me? *Bertil reads the note attached eagerly*

Pages.Speaker: Bertil
Pages.Text: *blushing* How wonderful...who are these from?
Pages.Choice: They are from a secret admirer, who I cannot reveal to you.

Pages.Speaker: Bertil
Pages.Text: Oh, I wonder who it could be...

Pages.Speaker: Bertil
Pages.Text: Will you kindly please tell him they are Lovely!

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: It must have been some trip.  Thank you very much.  I would like to help you in any situation.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: You have returned!

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Did she like the Special Bouquet?

Pages.Speaker: $character
Pages.Text: She said it was LOVELY!

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: I am overjoyed to hear that she liked the flowers.

Pages.Speaker: Fisk
Pages.Text: Thank you so much!
